added.en: Paginated points collection with ten stamps per page, driven by the current points balance.
added.zh-CN: 新增积分集章，每页十枚，按当前积分余额显示并支持翻页。

changed.en: Full-bleed bronze, silver and gold membership artwork with soft gradients and a locally blurred cardholder area.
changed.zh-CN: 铜、银、金会员卡采用独立的整卡背景，通过柔和渐变和持卡人区域的局部柔焦融合。

changed.en: Precompressed card artwork, static touch layouts and subtle desktop hover feedback.
changed.zh-CN: 卡面采用预压缩图片，触屏保持静态，桌面提供轻微悬停反馈。

changed.en: Responsive member navigation and points layout; head-office phone metrics, navigation drawer and compact member directories.
changed.zh-CN: 优化会员导航和积分布局，以及总部手机指标、导航抽屉与紧凑会员目录。

changed.en: Local Noto Sans and Noto Sans SC across all surfaces, including tabular member numbers and amounts.
changed.zh-CN: 三端统一使用本地 Noto Sans 与 Noto Sans SC，会员编号和金额保留等宽数字。

fixed.en: Removed the white DADE logo backing and retained the original transparent logo at its correct aspect ratio.
fixed.zh-CN: 移除 DADE Logo 白色衬底，保留官方透明原图与正确比例。

fixed.en: Search clearing restores input focus; member directories and navigation support arrow keys, Home and End.
fixed.zh-CN: 清空搜索后恢复输入框焦点，会员目录及导航支持方向键、Home 和 End。

fixed.en: Responsive wrapping and cardholder contrast for long names, store labels, balances and activity amounts.
fixed.zh-CN: 修正长姓名、门店名、余额和活动金额换行，以及长卡片姓名区域的文字对比度。

added.en: Bilingual, responsive member, staff and head-office surfaces with a neutral visual theme.
added.zh-CN: 采用中性主题的双语响应式会员、员工与总部界面。

added.en: Digital membership card, QR code, points and tier views, reward catalogue and activity details.
added.zh-CN: 数字会员卡、会员二维码、积分与等级视图、礼品目录和活动详情。

added.en: Store-scoped member views and head-office overview, member, store and staff directories.
added.zh-CN: 受门店范围限制的会员视图，以及总部概览、会员、门店和员工目录。

added.en: International phone input with Singapore +65 as the default, bilingual country search and E.164 validation.
added.zh-CN: 默认新加坡 +65 的国际号码输入、双语国家搜索与 E.164 校验。

added.en: SQLite schema migrations, aggregate projections, bounded reads, session storage and server-side access checks.
added.zh-CN: SQLite 结构迁移、汇总投影、限量查询、会话存储与服务端访问校验。

added.en: Standalone application packaging, local fonts, unit tests and isolated production-runtime integration checks.
added.zh-CN: 独立应用打包、本地字体、单元测试及隔离的生产构建集成检查。

added.en: DADE Membership repository baseline and bilingual product README.
added.zh-CN: DADE Membership 仓库基线与双语产品 README。

added.en: Version consistency validation and continuous integration workflow.
added.zh-CN: 版本一致性校验及持续集成流程。

added.en: Repository exclusions for local planning, credentials and runtime data.
added.zh-CN: 本地规划、凭据及运行数据的仓库排除配置。
